hero.headline: Franchise Process
hero.subheadline: A transparent, step-by-step journey from application to becoming an active RCF franchise partner.

stages.title: Online Application
stages.desc: Fill the online franchise application form with your personal details, business information, investment capacity, and preferred location. Upload required documents.

stages.title: Application Review
stages.desc: RCF's franchise team reviews your application for completeness and initial eligibility. You receive an acknowledgement with your Application ID.

stages.title: KYC Verification
stages.desc: Submit KYC documents for verification. Our field team may conduct a physical verification of your proposed business location.

stages.title: Background Check
stages.desc: RCF conducts a background check including financial history, existing business credentials, and market reputation in your area.

stages.title: Approval Letter
stages.desc: Upon successful verification, RCF issues a formal Approval Letter with your franchise tier, territory, and terms of engagement.

stages.title: Franchise Agreement
stages.desc: Sign the official RCF Franchise Agreement. Review terms carefully. Agreement covers territory rights, pricing, conduct, and renewal conditions.

stages.title: Security Deposit & Investment
stages.desc: Pay the refundable security deposit and initial investment as per your franchise tier. Payment via NEFT/RTGS to RCF's designated account.

stages.title: Infrastructure Setup
stages.desc: Set up your franchise outlet as per RCF's guidelines — signage, storage, display, and safety requirements. RCF provides a setup checklist.

stages.title: Training Programme
stages.desc: Attend RCF's mandatory 3-day franchise training programme covering product knowledge, government schemes, portal usage, and sales techniques.

stages.title: Stock Allocation
stages.desc: RCF allocates your initial stock based on your tier and territory. Stock is dispatched from the nearest RCF warehouse to your location.

stages.title: Franchise Activated
stages.desc: Your RCF franchise is officially activated! You receive your Franchise ID, portal credentials, and can begin selling RCF products to farmers.

timeline.note: Timeline may vary based on document completeness and location verification requirements.

faq.q: Can I apply from any state in India?
faq.a: Yes, RCF accepts franchise applications from all states and union territories across India.
Yes, the security deposit is fully refundable upon termination of the franchise agreement, subject to no outstanding dues.

faq.q: Do I need an existing fertilizer license?
faq.a: A fertilizer license is required before the franchise is activated. RCF's team can guide you through the license application process.
